title: Brand Owner Credential
description: Issued to a legal entity that has the right to use a brand because it is the direct owner or a licensee of that brand.

v.description: Version string using ACDC conventions, encoding protocol, serialization, and size.

d.description: SAID of the credential (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

u.description: A salty nonce (high-entropy random value) used to prevent rainbow-table attacks on the credential SAID.

i.description: AID of the issuer (the party certifying the brand ownership right).

ri.description: SAID of the issuer's ACDC credential status registry.

s.description: SAID of this schema (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

d.description: SAID of the attributes block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

u.description: A salty nonce for the attributes block, enabling selective disclosure.

i.description: AID of the legal entity that is the direct owner or licensee of the brand.

dt.description: Issuance date-time (when the ACDC was signed), as an ISO-8601 datetime string with timezone.

vcard.description: An ordered list of unfolded, VCard content lines (properties) per RFC 6350, where property and parameter names are upper case, and parameter names appear in lexicographic order. Values that are telephone numbers MUST be in strict E164 format with a leading + but no other spaces or punctuation. The CHATBOT property is standard and is of type URI. If the type of a particular value is URI and refers to static media files (as, for example, with LOGO), the HASH parameter SHOULD be included and MUST be the CESR-encoded value of the content at the URI. Alternatively, data URIs MAY be used. A URI that refers to mutable content SHOULD NOT be used, as it is insecure; if present, the credential is asserting only the location, not the content of the logo.

goals.description: Goal codes (see https://bit.ly/49V8YqV) that enumerate formally-defined activities in which the brand's owner might engage using the asserted brand attributes. If specified, activities not covered by these goal codes are considered contexts in which the legitimate use of the brand is not asserted by this credential.

d.description: SAID of the edges block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

issuer.description: Credential that proves the identity of the issuer.

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the identity of the issuer.

s.description: SAID of the schema that the issuer identity credential must satisfy.

o.description: Edge operator. I2I (default): issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to. NI2I: issuer AID MAY or MAY NOT be the issuee AID of that node. DI2I: issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID or a delegated AID of the issuee AID of that node. NOT: inverts the validity of the node this edge points to.

brandauth.description: Credential that proves the brand authority (e.g., a trademark registration or license agreement).

n.description: SAID of a credential that proves the brand authority.

s.description: SAID of the schema that the brand authority credential must satisfy.

o.description: Edge operator. I2I (default): issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID of the node this edge points to. NI2I: issuer AID MAY or MAY NOT be the issuee AID of that node. DI2I: issuer AID MUST be the issuee AID or a delegated AID of the issuee AID of that node. NOT: inverts the validity of the node this edge points to.

oneOf.description: SAID of rules block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding)

d.description: SAID of the rules block (Blake3-256 digest in CESR compact encoding).

governance.description: Statement identifying the governance framework under which this credential was issued.
